title: The Bill To column shows when the payer's row is on a later page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, owned by customer A, with more work orders at the test location than the tab shows on its first page: all bill customer A except the oldest, work order 1, which is billed to customer B and sits on a later page.
custom_steps: 1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A "Bill To" column shows on the first page, because work order 1 bills customer B, although work order 1 is not on the first page.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R6: “A "Bill To" column shows when at least one row bills someone else; it is blank on self-billed rows.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
